stem: A rooftop garden is a square with side length \(s\) meters. The garden is extended by 3 meters along one side only, making a rectangular garden with an area of 70 square meters. What is the value of \(s\)?
solution: The new rectangle is \(s\) by \(s + 3\), so \(s(s + 3) = 70\), or \(s^{2} + 3s - 70 = 0\).
Factor: \((s + 10)(s - 7) = 0\). A length is positive, so \(s = 7\).

explanation.A: Incorrect. This is the length of the extended side, \(s + 3\), not the original side.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This is \(70 \div 2\); the area is \(s(s + 3)\), not \(2s\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. \(-10\) satisfies the equation but cannot be a side length.

verify:
s = symbols('s', positive=True)
sol = solve(Eq(s*(s + 3), 70), s)
assert sol == [7]
ans = 7
assert value(choices[answer]) == ans
assert all(value(choices[k]) != ans for k in choices if k != answer)
